reply.summary: Aneor is a bald, black-eyed chemist who as a boy gorged on carrion and found himself stronger, then became the chosen vessel of a council devoted to decay. Aneor spent more than a century murdering champions of living nature.

feats.scene: Aneor spreads a blight that rots a whole village's orchards and homes in an hour.
Aneor keeps walking after a collapsing chapel buries him in rubble.

reply.summary: Miialeru is a coastal researcher who built a serum that lets people breathe seawater, and who later carried a machine-made infection granting great strength and durability. Miialeru lives among the drowned districts he unintentionally saved.

feats.scene: Miialeru fires a bolt of pent-up energy that tears the hull from a patrol boat.
Miialeru is hit by a cargo container swung from a crane and keeps working.

reply.summary: Colam is a red-haired electrical expert and reincarnated tyrant who once flew an eye-shaped airship powered by the pooled willpower of scholars. Colam is the oldest foe of a winged hero.

feats.scene: Colam discharges the airship's coils and blows the roof off a power station.
Colam stumbles from a crashed cockpit with only scrapes.

reply.summary: Nenrela is a career thief in a cartoon city who vanishes from sight at the right moment, relying on flash and bad luck for opponents. Nenrela gets by on wit.

feats.scene: Nenrela jabs a security guard in the stomach and sprints for the window.
Nenrela survives a rough landing on a rooftop of gravel.

reply.summary: Iaarco is a grey-haired envoy who negotiated peace between worlds and resented young guardians sent to watch the talks. Iaarco was later puppeted by a mind-bending villain.

feats.scene: Iaarco slaps a treaty folder against the lectern to end a debate.
Iaarco stumbles from a conference stage and is only embarrassed.

reply.summary: Lentna is a dark-haired nobleman of a mountain castle who moves objects with his mind and turns soil into obedient clay giants. Lentna descends from an ancient warlord.

feats.scene: Lentna raises three earthen giants that flatten a stone barn.
Lentna is thrown against a battlement and rises to his feet.

reply.summary: Eosarntu is a silver-skinned young woman born of an alien experiment, able to shoot bursts of grey plasma. Eosarntu joined a team of teen heroes and grieved hard when a friend seemed to die.

feats.scene: Eosarntu hurls a plasma burst that melts a parked bus to slag.
Eosarntu shrugs off a collapsing wall of plaster and wire.

reply.summary: Setiran is a black-haired frontier lawman who served a young republic in the 1840s, patrolling dusty trails on horseback. Setiran has no gifts but a steady aim.

feats.scene: Setiran fires a rifle and drops a bandit's horse mid-gallop.
Setiran is dragged by a spooked mount for fifty yards and walks off.

reply.summary: Iutau was a trapeze artist who fell to his death during a show where the owner skimped on nets. Iutau's grieving siblings then turned to crime in his memory.

feats.scene: Iutau pushes off the platform bar with both feet.
Iutau lands hard on sawdust from a low swing without injury.

reply.summary: Nanri is a brown-haired counsellor to a criminal syndicate, a fluent, well-read polyglot who knows the rivals' dealings but protects his own relatives first. Nanri keeps a friendship with a police detective.

feats.scene: Nanri closes a heavy ledger with a thud to end a meeting.
Nanri is bumped into a doorframe and shrugs it off.

reply.summary: Anumiial is a white-haired, sightless winged deity who ruled the sky and lived so long he outlasted nearly every living thing. Anumiial waited at the end of time for the last act of the cosmos.

feats.scene: Anumiial beats his wings once and a storm front spans a whole hemisphere.
Anumiial remains standing as the last stars gutter around him.
Anumiial soars across the dying sky in moments.

reply.summary: Rnren is a young rebel from a grim possible future who is strong, tough and surrounded by a protective barrier. Rnren charged a tyrant's hovercraft and was killed by two energy bolts.

feats.scene: Rnren rips the door off a patrol hovercraft with both hands.
Rnren holds the barrier up as a barrage of cannon fire hammers it.

reply.summary: Tetelil is a frail white-haired priest of a far world who helped a warrior woman free captives from invaders. Tetelil leans on a walking stick and knows the old rites.

feats.scene: Tetelil raps his stick on a stone floor to call a gathering.
Tetelil is shoved by a guard and catches himself against a pillar.

reply.summary: Vital is a hairless, black-skinned sovereign of the eastern waters, a dragon who rules a coastal realm and nurses a long rivalry with a trickster ape. Vital commands tides and sea-folk.

feats.scene: Vital lashes his tail and a tidal wall drowns a coastline.
Vital rides out a whirlpool that tears apart a fleet.

reply.summary: Amiont is a black-haired sword-for-hire from a subterranean land who senses the future and wears a crown inherited from a wicked ancestor. Amiont chose to defend the weak.

feats.scene: Amiont cuts through a wooden barricade in two strokes.
Amiont keeps fighting with a deep cut across her arm.

reply.summary: Rnseso is a tribal hero who shouts a battle word to swell into a towering colossus, usually the height of a tall building and at times truly cosmic. Rnseso also has a keen inner sense for hidden danger.

feats.scene: Rnseso swells to colossal size and flattens a bridge tower with one stamp.
Rnseso stays upright as a crane collapses across his giant shoulders.

reply.summary: Tesre is a gorilla who learned speech and fire and declared himself fit to rule, rallying jungle primates to terrorise villages. Tesre's human henchmen eventually turned on him.

feats.scene: Tesre swings a thick branch and shatters a hut wall.
Tesre takes a fall from a tall tree and keeps climbing.

reply.summary: Rnenteon is a pink-eyed deity of love and desire whose affection can bind the will of those who adore her. Rnenteon lends a slice of her might to a mortal champion and does not age or die.

feats.scene: Rnenteon sighs and every watcher on a mountain slope falls helplessly in love, shaking the slope loose.
Rnenteon is unmarked by a thunderbolt from a rival deity.

reply.summary: Valti is a white-haired heroine in a mirror-image world, the flipped counterpart of a sun-themed hero, who flies a team's giant airborne base. Valti is rumoured to be in love with a fellow hero.

feats.scene: Valti rams the airborne base through a tower facade.
Valti survives a missile salvo against the base's armour.

reply.summary: Vaeon is a goddess of love and beauty and patron of an island nation of warrior women, who answered a queen's plea and sealed that nation away. Vaeon never ages and can move between realms.

feats.scene: Vaeon raises a mist-wall around a whole island that no ship can cross.
Vaeon remains unharmed as a god-king's army hurls spears at her.

reply.summary: Valco is a blue-eyed, blond goddess of love and beauty worshipped in the ancient world and patron of a hidden island of warrior women. Valco watches over her devotees from a lofty mountain home.

feats.scene: Valco conjures a blossoming storm that strips a hillside of every thorn.
Valco stands untouched under a rockslide.

reply.summary: Tecar is a black-haired, white-eyed goddess and one of five divine mothers who raised a nation of warriors and gave them gifts, though she cannot fully take form in the physical world. Tecar commands water.

feats.scene: Tecar lifts an ocean swell and sets it down gently around a new island.
Tecar is dispersed into mist by a blow and slowly reforms.

reply.summary: Iuanceo is a pink-haired deity of love who teaches her restless son that affection must be inspired, not forced, after his meddling causes a chaotic wedding brawl. Iuanceo never dies.

feats.scene: Iuanceo claps once and an entire brawling crowd falls calm.
Iuanceo is unmoved by a barrage of villains' blasts.

reply.summary: Aulto is a green-eyed, red-haired deity of love, a daughter of the sky-king, who proudly recalls giving fallen women a new life on a paradise isle. Aulto is deathless and sharp-tongued.

feats.scene: Aulto raises an island from the sea and covers it in blooms.
Aulto stands unscathed in a storm of divine lightning.

reply.summary: Cortia is a black-maned, brown-eyed horse who carries a masked rider through frontier skirmishes in wartime. Cortia is steady, fast and loyal.

feats.scene: Cortia kicks a fence rail in half while spooked by gunfire.
Cortia gallops through brambles and a hail of bullets without a mark.
Cortia sprints flat out across an open prairie.

reply.summary: Erneru is a white-eyed, golden-haired sun deity who flies, controls light and cannot die, and who brought an infant to a witch while forbidding a certain word. Erneru answers only to a father-king.

feats.scene: Erneru focuses sunlight into a lance that boils a whole bay.
Erneru walks through a volcanic eruption without a singed hair.

reply.summary: Nescaeon is a brown-haired, deathless archer-god of a forgotten empire, quick with a bow and a quiver of arrows. Nescaeon lives on in a parallel world's legends.

feats.scene: Nescaeon looses a flaming arrow that levels a watchtower.
Nescaeon takes a boulder to the chest and laughs it off.

reply.summary: Teelnt is a white-haired, brown-eyed wandering swordsman, gentle until provoked, who killed a band of drunks in one stroke and later fell in love with a shogun's bodyguard. Teelnt died fighting hundreds of assassins in the night.

feats.scene: Teelnt draws and cuts down a whole row of attackers in a single sweep.
Teelnt keeps fighting through dozens of cuts before he drops.

reply.summary: Taltestel is a brown-haired space-age adventurer with cat-like gifts: strength, speed, reflexes, claws, fast recovery and a rapport with animals. Taltestel serves in a team of young heroes across the stars.

feats.scene: Taltestel rakes her claws through a metal hatch and rips it from its frame.
Taltestel lands from a high ledge on all fours without injury.
Taltestel bounds down a long corridor in seconds.

reply.summary: Anevaco is a tentacled, eyeless officer of a galactic police force who was called to arrest a notorious vigilante and was killed by him. Anevaco carries little record beyond that single fight.

feats.scene: Anevaco lashes a tentacle and flings a metal chair across the room.
Anevaco survives a hard slam into a wall before being overwhelmed.

reply.summary: Restost is a tall, eyeless, genderless veteran of a cosmic police force who founded its elite guard and trains recruits. Restost wields a power ring that makes solid light constructs, shields and beams and enables flight.

feats.scene: Restost casts a green construct ram and punches a hole through a bunker.
Restost's shield holds against a salvo of artillery shells.

reply.summary: Valtor is an eyeless, genderless alien officer of an interstellar peacekeeping corps, equipped with a ring and a charging battery, who relies on unbending resolve. Valtor can summon constructs, a force shield and blasts, and can fly.

feats.scene: Valtor fires a concentrated beam that bores through a freight hull.
Valtor holds a barrier against a crashing starship's debris.

reply.summary: Reorvi is a tentacled, eyeless peacekeeper in a cartoon cosmos, armed with a ring that builds shapes from light, throws blasts, raises shields and flies. Reorvi serves a galactic police corps.

feats.scene: Reorvi blasts a rogue robot and its chassis splits in half.
Reorvi's shield withstands a heavy cannon round.

reply.summary: Tileta is a bodiless being of living kinetic force, seen by her twin as a faint face in her mind. Tileta can be shaped to lift her host aloft and move others, but cannot exist without a host.

feats.scene: Tileta channels a surge of force through her sister and shatters a brick wall.
Tileta disperses and re-forms after an incoming blast passes through her.

reply.summary: Torial is a white-haired, black-eyed cow in a pint-sized cartoon world, a swimming pet of a young sea heroine who joins a club of heroic cattle. Torial lives happily under the waves.

feats.scene: Torial butts a beach ball clear across the pool.
Torial gets knocked into a coral wall and shakes it off.
Torial paddles hard to reach her owner's side.

reply.summary: Carlanleo is a yellow-eyed weapons scientist whose body was merged with lake water after a failed teleport experiment, leaving him obsessed with ruling the seas. Carlanleo built a huge cannon to wreck the moon.

feats.scene: Carlanleo's cannon backfires and its blast levels the whole fortress.
Carlanleo reforms his liquid body after a hail of gunfire passes through him.

reply.summary: Liastiial is a black-haired, black-eyed girl of a sunken city who leads a pint-sized team of sea heroes and breathes both air and water. Liastiial's club was overrun by tiny parasitic starfish.

feats.scene: Liastiial flicks a tail and sends a boulder-sized sponge rolling.
Liastiial endures a tumble through a rocky reef.
Liastiial darts between coral heads in pursuit of a friend.

reply.summary: Llererva is a black-haired young sea-city hero who aids a teen team, with webbed skin, quick swimming, a friendly bond with creatures and a talent for diving. Llererva helped a lost sea girl return home with her turtle.

feats.scene: Llererva shoulders a heavy fish crate off a dock.
Llererva takes a hard tumble in a flooded tank and recovers quickly.
Llererva streaks across the bay faster than a speedboat.

reply.summary: Saualsor is a blue-eyed, brown-haired ocean hero wielding a three-pronged spear, who joined a team of champions against a wave of annihilating matter. Saualsor was erased with the rest of his reality, then restored elsewhere.

feats.scene: Saualsor drives his spear into the seabed and a wave capsizes a tanker.
Saualsor shrugs off a cannonade of depth charges.

reply.summary: Telsor is a black-haired killer in a team of assassins, fitted with machine enhancements and skilled with arms. Telsor was slaughtered alongside the squad by a mysterious doom.

feats.scene: Telsor fires a rifle round through a steel door.
Telsor keeps advancing after taking a burst to the armoured chest.

reply.summary: Oluson is a black-haired, black-eyed sea champion of a doomed alliance who rescued his teammates from a collapsing base by calling on a pod of dolphins. Oluson vanished when his whole world was wiped away.

feats.scene: Oluson hurls a harpoon and pins a drifting buoy.
Oluson dives through the falling wreckage and surfaces unharmed.

reply.summary: Ullananu is a big blond hermit raised alone in a hidden sea lab, whose body adapted to live underwater with great strength and the ability to breathe in the ocean. Ullananu befriends sea creatures and declined to join famed teams.

feats.scene: Ullananu wrenches a submarine's propeller shaft in two.
Ullananu endures deep-sea pressure and a torpedo glancing blow.

reply.summary: Irnam is a green and gold dinosaur with a long snout who guards coastal fishing villages from sea predators. Irnam has near-impenetrable hide, claws, fangs, powerful limbs, and fights with a three-pronged spear.

feats.scene: Irnam clamps his jaws on a giant sea beast and flings it onto the shore.
Irnam's hide turns aside a giant squid's crushing grip.

reply.summary: Siltor is a near-omnipotent sentient star who was exiled from his peers for monstrous crimes, then regained his full might and erased every world save a few survivors. Siltor was undone only by a sacrifice that broke his hold.

feats.scene: Siltor lets loose a wave of fire that wipes an entire universe from existence.
Siltor shrugs off the combined assault of countless champions.

reply.summary: Seono is a black-haired, black-eyed member of a three-part villain who was shaped by laboratory experiments and fights a band of misfit heroes in a cartoon world. Seono is a minor menace.

feats.scene: Seono hurls a metal canister across a lab.
Seono shakes off a blow from a heavy wrench.

reply.summary: Enura is a brain-shaped alien envoy of a warlike faction who posed as a humble aide while plotting an assassination with a secret conspiracy. Enura outranks the ambassador he serves.

feats.scene: Enura hurls a beam of mental pressure that cracks a window.
Enura shrugs off a stumble from a high stair.

reply.summary: Sonin is an eyeless alien lawkeeper of a remote sector who passed his power ring to a successor three millennia ago and was later honoured in a crypt. Sonin wielded a ring with constructs, shields, blasts and flight.

feats.scene: Sonin shapes a glowing wrecking sphere and flattens a bandit fort.
Sonin's shield turns aside a barrage of siege cannon fire.

reply.summary: Ntmiares is a brown-eyed demigod warrior raised by seafaring raiders after surviving a sinking canoe, deadly with a small axe, sword, shield and bow. Ntmiares journeyed across three continents in the eighth century.

feats.scene: Ntmiares splits a raider's shield with a single axe stroke.
Ntmiares fights on after a sea serpent's tail sweeps him off the deck.

reply.summary: Sornint is a former warrior-prince made the living avatar of a blood-red moon by a cosmic machine, tasked with deciding which stolen cities survive. Sornint was restored after creation's rebirth as a wandering hero.

feats.scene: Sornint calls down a ray from the red moon that scorches a continent.
Sornint stands firm as a rival city's weapons bombard the moon.

reply.summary: Ilsava is a prince of a desert kingdom who turned his back on royal duty to become the finest burglar in the land, skilled with a blade and with locks. Ilsava now travels beside a famous warlord.

feats.scene: Ilsava slashes a guard's belt and a coin purse drops to the floor.
Ilsava drops from a palace wall into a hay cart and runs on.
